title: Great for freezing soup
text: Great for freezing soup. I purchased these to use for freezing soup for the winter for quick dinners.  These work perfect for that.  They store nicely in the freezer and hold the right amount of soup for my needs.  They are very durable, not a thin flimsy product.  I would recommend these no matter what you are looking to use them for.  Microwavable too.
